Hi Mina —

Attaching the MAP we reviewed with Emily and the GTM team this morning (attached: SummitGrove-MAP-v1.2.xlsx). High level: SummitGrove has committed to a phased rollout across two product lines (Search and Assist). Key dates proposed below — none are hard until we get your sign-off on owners and the network window.

Proposed milestones (first-pass):
- Week 0 (2026-06-07): Kickoff + environment access exchange (Redwood dev accounts, SummitGrove test cluster).
- Week 1-2 (2026-06-14 to 2026-06-25): Integration sprint A — API connectivity, auth, and basic inference calls.
- Week 3 (2026-06-28): Performance validation (latency targets, baseline throughput).
- Week 4-6 (2026-07-05 to 2026-07-16): Feature gating and acceptance testing for Search.
- Week 7-8 (2026-07-19 to 2026-07-30): Assist pilot and cross-product regression pass.

Open items for CS/Delivery to confirm:
1) Which CS engineer will own the weekly cadence with SummitGrove (owner for weekly 30m sync + 1x go-live readiness call).
2) Network maintenance window from SummitGrove (needed for dedicated connector install).
3) Any additional compliance artifacts they need before per-product data onboarding.

Ben — can you take the infra checklist and confirm the GPU pool sizing note in the MAP (sheet: infra-notes)?

Mina — can you confirm who will be the day-to-day CS owner and propose kickoff slots next week? I penciled in Tue/Wed morning PST.

Thanks — attaching the MAP and the network requirements PDF for the engineering team.

- Signed deployment checklist and remediation plan attached to the workbook.

I will schedule the kickoff once Emily confirms the slot and once Ben confirms infra availability.

Emily — great, thanks for confirming the kickoff slot and for the SAML metadata. Below is the finalized sprint timetable and owner roster; I pasted this into the thread so it's visible in the calendar invite notes.

Final sprint timetable (dates are target windows):
- Kickoff: 2026-06-08 09:30 PT — Owners: Mina (Redwood CS), Emily (SummitGrove Prod). Agenda: introductions, access checklist, confirm next steps.
- Integration Sprint A: 2026-06-09 to 2026-06-23 — Owners: Ben (Redwood Infra), SummitGrove Eng. Goal: API auth, infra connectivity, smoke tests.
- Performance Validation: 2026-06-24 to 2026-06-28 — Owners: Ben + Mina. Deliverable: p95 latency report and remediation log.
- Search Acceptance Testing: 2026-06-29 to 2026-07-09 — Owners: Mina + SummitGrove QA. Deliverable: pass/fail matrix on labeled prompts.
- Assist Pilot: 2026-07-12 to 2026-07-23 — Owners: Product/PD and Redwood Delivery. Deliverable: pilot runbook and support rotation.
- Go-live readiness window: 2026-07-26 to 2026-07-30 — Owners: Mina, SummitGrove Ops, Ben. Deliverable: signed cutover checklist and rollback plan.

Acceptance criteria (finalized):
- Latency: p95 <= 250ms for Search, measured at 256 tokens in our test harness.
- Quality: >= 92% QA pass rate on labeled prompts for both products.
- Security: Staging tenant provisioned and SAML connected; logs retained for 30 days for pilot.
- Operational: On-call rotation and escalation matrix agreed and documented in the MAP workbook.

Open / action items (owner — due):
- Ben — confirm Dedicated staging slot and capacity reservation by 2026-06-04.
- SummitGrove Eng — provide SAML metadata (received) and confirm maintenance blackout windows by 2026-06-04.
- Mina — send calendar invite (30m kickoff) and attach finalized MAP + agenda by EOD 2026-06-03.
- Marissa — prepare SOW addendum and DocuSign link for pilot terms (deliver by 2026-06-07).

Attachments (final): SummitGrove-MAP-v1.2.xlsx, Network-Reqs.pdf. DocuSign SOW (link in related_links).

If anyone needs us to slide any of the windows by a few days to accommodate internal change freezes, flag it here and we'll update the MAP version number. Otherwise I'll publish MAP v1.2 as the working document and add the meeting invite.

Thanks — looking forward to kickoff.
